recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-25514 unless Patient Care later decides to create a new computable rule for negated AllergyIntolerance clinicalStatus expectations.
issue_request: FHIR-25514 was a Published/Persuasive Patient Care change request for R5 asking to remove the AllergyIntolerance ait-1 invariant because requiring clinicalStatus for all non-entered-in-error records was inappropriate for no-known-allergy/negated AllergyIntolerance instances. The resolution requested replacing the invariant with a comment recommending clinicalStatus only when verificationStatus is not entered-in-error and AllergyIntolerance.code is not negated.
initial_application: The Jira-linked commit a793a6b7db286814f69c9de8908c1f77bbfec526 removed clinicalStatus and verificationStatus from no-known-allergy examples, added the requested comment to the AllergyIntolerance spreadsheet, added GF#25514 to committee notes, and disabled the old clinicalStatus-required invariant row. The later source refactor 33b409a4b6d544598262f2f074ebb4b6dc466157 carried that state into source/allergyintolerance/structuredefinition-AllergyIntolerance.xml.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists AllergyIntolerance as an active resource and assigns it to Patient Care. Current AllergyIntolerance source has the requested clinicalStatus comment, no active ait-1 constraint or condition, and no-known-allergy examples without clinicalStatus. Later Published issue FHIR-28458 explicitly removed remaining AllergyIntolerance clinicalStatus invariants, reinforcing the no-invariant state. FHIR-26410 was implemented by the same historical commit for related no-known-allergy guidance and is already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current build-scope source already satisfies FHIR-25514 and a source edit would be redundant or contrary to later related decisions.

related_jiras.note: Clarified no-known-allergy coding guidance in the same a793a6b implementation commit and is already represented on the combined branch.
Later Published issue removed remaining AllergyIntolerance clinicalStatus invariants, supporting the current no-invariant state.
Earlier issue repaired broken AllergyIntolerance/Condition invariant expressions, but its comments note FHIR-28458 later made the AllergyIntolerance invariant portion no longer applicable.
